key.name: paused
key.summary: Paused by hand (the live-toggle shortcut flips this)

key.name: embers
key.summary: Embers rising from the bottom of the screen

key.name: glow
key.summary: Slow pulse on the crimson parts of the art

key.name: parallax
key.summary: Wallpaper shifts slightly with the pointer (works on live videos too, and while the particles are paused)

key.name: parallax-strength
key.summary: How far the parallax moves (1 = up to 1 % of the screen; the art is zoomed just enough to hide the edges)

key.name: depth
key.summary: 3D wallpaper: near parts of the picture move more than far ones as the pointer moves (needs a depth map — bapirlo-wallpaper depth)

key.name: depth-strength
key.summary: How strong the 3D effect is (1 = near and far split by up to 2.5 % of the screen)

key.name: depth-drift
key.summary: Slow 3D sway even when the pointer is still (runs only when the animation may: not paused, covered, on battery…)

key.name: fps
key.summary: Frames per second of the animation (the screen itself stays at its own refresh rate)

key.name: pause-on-battery
key.summary: Stop the animation while running on battery

key.name: pause-in-power-saver
key.summary: Stop the animation in the power-saver profile (Eco / quiet mode)

key.name: search-focus
key.summary: Wallpaper follows app search: blur, zoom and drift behind the overview / app grid and ArcMenu
